g.text: Shared stochastic rank-two probability class · Independent uniform reference · Unrestricted backward features

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #087d72
font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #182e40

g.text: Two equally likely starts · Two actions each · Four terminal outcomes · γ = 0 · Reward on arrival

text.style: font-size: 10.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5c6d7b

g.text: The same four terminal states appear in both panels. Training samples all four start–action pairs equally.

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5c6d7b

g.text: Δ = value(A) − value(B). Actions maximize the displayed value; success is always evaluated in the true MDP.

text.style: font-size: 11.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #182e40

g.text: Reference matters: the natural marginal is (0.49, 0.49, 0.01, 0.01); using it restores the correct FB ordering.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #182e40

g.text: A two-feature FB model can preserve the exact action differences for every reward.

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5c6d7b

g.text: Finite-capacity population construction · Exact reward integration · No learned actor or reward-inference evaluation
